title: Product photo brief
prompt: Describe a clean product photo of [product] on [background] for [use]. Name the light, the angle, and what must stay out of the frame.
popularity_note: A brief you can hand to an image tool.

title: Logo ideas in words
prompt: Give me five logo ideas for [business] in plain words. For each, name the shape, the colors, and one reason it fits [customer]. Words only, no images yet.
popularity_note: Ideas in words before any design work.

title: Shot list for a short clip
prompt: Make a shot list for a [length] clip about [topic]. Number each shot, say what the camera sees, and keep it to [number] shots.
popularity_note: A numbered list you can film from.

title: Video opening lines
prompt: Write five opening lines for a video about [topic] for [audience]. Keep each one under 12 words. Draft only.
popularity_note: Five openers to pick from. Nothing is posted.

title: Offer in one sentence
prompt: Write one sentence that says what [offer] is, who it is for, and what it costs. Use only these facts: [facts].
popularity_note: One clear line about your offer.

title: Meeting notes to actions
prompt: Turn these meeting notes into a list of actions with an owner and a due date for each: [notes]. Leave a blank where the notes do not say.
popularity_note: Actions with owners, gaps left blank.

title: One-page proposal
prompt: Draft a one-page proposal for [client] about [job]. Use only these facts: [facts]. Leave the price blank if I did not give one.
popularity_note: A proposal tied to the facts you give.

title: Spreadsheet columns
prompt: Suggest the columns for a spreadsheet that tracks [what]. Give each column a name and an example value, and say which ones need a formula.
popularity_note: A sheet layout before you type anything.

title: Explain a formula
prompt: Explain this spreadsheet formula in plain words, step by step: [formula]. Then show one small example with made-up numbers marked as examples.

title: Home page outline
prompt: Outline a home page for [business]. List the sections in order, a headline for each, and the one button people should click. Use only these facts: [facts].
popularity_note: A page plan with one clear button.

title: Why the page breaks
prompt: Look at this web page code and tell me in plain words why [problem] happens: [code]. Suggest the smallest fix. Do not rewrite the whole page.

title: Phone call script
prompt: Write a short phone script for calling [name] about [offer]. Start with who I am, ask one question, and end with a next step. Draft only.
popularity_note: A short script you can edit.

title: Reply to a comment
prompt: Draft a friendly reply to this comment on my [platform] post: [comment]. Keep it under [length]. Do not argue. Draft only.
popularity_note: A calm reply. Nothing is posted.
